3a42a9f193a6.text: Player profiles now show current and previous teams, with available membership history.

f7b49f6c8463.text: Team pages show a roster history of current and former members.

89596e81fe19.text: The team activity feed shows when players join, rejoin, leave or are removed.

f9c4d41045fc.text: A new Changelog page under Info shows patch notes by day, with search, filters and a dot for new changes.

d8ca01b3772f.text: EU and SA are now separate region groups, and the Play page counts the queue for your region group.

f3268a5378e2.text: Each region group can open or close matchmaking modes on its own, and the Play page shows what is open in your region.

19f5fcb4b846.text: If a mode closes while you are in its queue, you leave the queue and get a message.

ae58f44b7546.text: Choose EU or SA from a dropdown in settings or on your profile. Staff approve the change.

b109b1cd6dcc.text: Press Ctrl+K (Cmd+K on Mac) or use Search in the left menu to find pages, players, FAQ answers and your settings.

2768db97a410.text: Your notifications, friends and My Matches appear sooner when a page opens.

47f623659684.text: Stream and demo startup progress now shows the workshop map download in the right order.

486b0c283922.text: The Teams page, league seasons, tournament bracket previews and the utility library stay quick when many people view them at once.

5fb8edf2e80b.text: When a mode is closed, a ready check that fails no longer puts you back in its queue or starts a new one.

863731fcebc3.text: A clip you make private leaves the public Highlights and Watch lists right away.

c9fd0d1574b6.text: Team cards show a space before "vs" in the Next and Last rows.

8515c0bb5967.text: The scoreboard keeps players in ADR order in every view, rows move smoothly when their positions change, and stat numbers roll like an odometer.

393f73b8e203.text: The team page tabs are one full-width bar under the team header, with the active tab highlighted, and it stays on screen while you scroll.

f86793cca68c.text: K/D, HS% and rating boards filtered by source or role load much faster.

39e86cf1e1b4.text: After your role changes, the site picks up your new permissions right away without a reload.

32b7ac45473d.text: A late duplicate status from a game server no longer ends the next map early or loses a map's result.

b6d18a5c3c0e.text: Steam messages that Steam delays or rate-limits are retried instead of lost, and are never sent twice.

e18a7d528797.text: Rebuilding a season's ratings now keeps its tournament matches, so season ELO stays correct.

fc8c1c15ce22.text: Report a Player opens 5 minutes after the match ends, and the match page shows the time left.

10269adda867.text: Player names show correctly when choosing who to report.

4c5a336bdec6.text: Report details no longer show an empty profile row.

b976ba6888c5.text: Report a Player opens 5 minutes after the match ends, without waiting for the stats.

061bb7cadaae.text: Match pages open faster, and the scoreboard keeps players in a steady ADR order during live matches.

713aa4000bf3.text: Older player reports show the reported player's profile link again.

e9ef02e1768e.text: Team kills, suicides and assists on teammates no longer count toward your kills, assists and weapon stats.

2ba40de71f38.text: Kill and K/D boards no longer count team kills or suicides as kills.

e5d2e718ce43.text: Stats tabs and the standings tiebreaker count kills and deaths the same way as everywhere else.

8a287f311e15.text: Report a player straight from their row on the scoreboard.

b094395dc281.text: The scoreboard and staff chat log show each player's CS2 teammate color.

efd2d89585f2.text: Organizers can turn ELO off for a tournament in its settings before the first match starts.

6008d6d300fd.text: Report a player from the "..." menu next to their name on the scoreboard.

2a00a1b885d0.text: Call for Support now explains where to report a player instead.

1d5f627e6589.text: Report a player in a popup on the match page, with a reason, map and round.

26f4c4d674d5.text: Players are reported only from the scoreboard on the match page, with a reason from the list.

149220ad0ccb.text: The Contact page shows with pictures how to call support in a match and how to report a player.

5a4fc3c84d08.text: Organizers can run a tournament without ELO, set before the first match starts.

e0d2b3cb104c.text: Report a player from their row on the scoreboard or the "..." menu next to their name, in a popup with a reason, the map and the round.

0645fd9fdc29.text: The scoreboard shows each player's CS2 teammate color.

e1d08c779ad0.text: Organizers can turn ELO off for a tournament in its settings, before the first match starts.

7df3e5a2b6ae.text: Verified players can open Public Servers in the Practice section, and each server card can show its own picture.

5780f0dacfa7.text: Call for Support now explains where to report a player instead.

23ea12233f93.text: Regions with only public servers (Deathmatch, Retake) no longer show up in matchmaking, so you can't queue where no match server can start.

0bfdff8123fe.text: Each day's patch notes are grouped by section, with a New, Improved or Fixed tag on every change.

419621377f8b.text: Match logs, system logs and RCON command suggestions show player names and plugin text as plain text.

30d3792d6086.text: Match page highlight clips load with less work for the site.

e750d5be9837.text: The Public Servers page and the Play page's server card load with less work for the site.

6a6a255898c9.text: Removing a category from a tournament works again.

3557fb8efe89.text: Free-agent-only tournaments offer "Join as a free agent" instead of "Register" on their cards.

c2005cd467d6.text: Leaderboards show fades and buttons on edges with more columns to scroll to.

2fd6e4198df8.text: Player profiles load with less work for the site and show changes made elsewhere on your next visit.

2288eff89b34.text: Share on a clip opens Copy link and Download, and a clip's owner and staff can delete it right from the tile.

558def02e51f.text: A deleted clip leaves every list and playlist without a reload.

cb73890b986a.text: Deleting the first clip of a match group shows the next clip right away instead of the deleted one.

66ec808a758d.text: Only a clip's creator and staff can change or delete it, and only its creator can rename it.

09781fa42df3.text: The left sidebar has clearer groups, with Community, Updates and Info sections.

c432a18b5b20.text: The Info section stays open or closed after a page reload, like the other sections.

0cc10e89691c.text: General, Matchmaking and Tournament Rules are now one Rules page with three tabs.

150dcaa26833.text: The Info section is shorter, and the collapsed sidebar shows it as one icon with a menu.

68f08866b211.text: Organizers can turn on AIM Rules for a Duel tournament: 3 second freeze time, free Kevlar, no buy time and a 3 second delay between rounds.

d26fe8c83c4c.text: Competitive ELO now depends mostly on the result and the strength of both teams.

1ff750d60a8a.text: Your match rating counts for up to 10% of your Competitive ELO change.

a2cf4ce954c7.text: Competitive gains and losses get smaller above 10,000 ELO, about ±50 at 20,000.

b7b8f55fe8c6.text: Leaving a Competitive, Wingman or Duel match now gives 50% of the gain if your team wins, or twice the loss if your team loses.

e7a5be4d69c5.text: In Duel and Wingman, wins against the same opponent are worth less after three meetings in 7 days. Losses aren't affected.

992308cce424.text: The ELO popup explains leaver and repeat opponent adjustments.

ea4bf01d8486.text: Your current ELO and past matches stay as they are. The new rules apply to matches that start from now on.

421db861484c.text: Cancelling a tournament or resetting it to Setup now asks for confirmation first.

0863fffd2339.text: The bracket shows the right best-of for the Grand Final.

c04528071747.text: Organizers can cancel a match that already has a demo.

65928848bb17.text: Canceled matches no longer count toward player statistics or leaderboards.

91706cc33b4d.text: A canceled match keeps its played maps, rounds and stats, even before its demo arrives.

5600e98df2af.text: Changing an earlier result no longer swaps the teams of a canceled match that was already played.

0851476f5443.text: A tournament can no longer be cancelled or deleted while its matches are being played.

d41ce9881ee2.text: A tournament with rated matches can no longer be deleted, which protects player ELO history.

f53de1b937c8.text: A match started again right after a cancel keeps its server.

0233bfa52e74.text: A canceled match that is started again replays the unfinished map from warmup and keeps its finished maps.

4b24659b931a.text: A tournament with played matches can no longer be reset to Setup.

3c0c204bc691.text: Organizers can recover an unfinished series without awarding a win, and resetting a match keeps its finished maps.

9800d6a7568d.text: Correcting the winner of a final now finishes the tournament again.

c7d665ec1489.text: Results that changed player ELO must have their ELO voided before they can be changed.

345b27a073aa.text: The Grand Final uses its own best-of and map advantage at any bracket size.

333b17ab2aee.text: Each mode shows its map pool when you hover or tap its info icon.

6e93cbb56da3.text: The Play page shows Competitive, Wingman and Duel in a cleaner layout on every screen size.

8f73193cd9b7.text: The match page shows the upper bracket team's Grand Final map advantage.

5193156b4818.text: A finished Grand Final shows the full series score, including the upper bracket advantage.

d23dc68e4e87.text: Maps a Grand Final did not need are muted and marked Not needed.

100d40e3ca2c.text: The bracket and match lists show a Grand Final's full series score, including the upper bracket advantage.

45c85933a812.text: Setting a map winner in a Grand Final counts the upper bracket team's map advantage.

1a22f8db4b89.text: DEAFCS Pro is a scheduled solo 5v5 queue with Captain Pick for top-ranked players.

bdff2109e4cc.text: Administrators can delete a tournament with rated matches without voiding ELO first.

b6546e684688.text: Organizers can reset or change a match winner without voiding ELO first.

4177bc80fd8c.text: The Awards board now ranks players by Gold, then Silver, Bronze, MVP and Special.

0631c64ebf9b.text: Stat tables can now be sorted with the keyboard and announce their sort order to screen readers.

d0a927cf64d6.text: Season awards show their season and game mode.

ebe13407f116.text: A player's Awards rank now matches their place on the board.

4e89e5afa34f.text: Season Gold, Silver and Bronze medals now count on the Awards board.

018c7398dbcc.text: Players are notified when they receive a season medal, and when one is revoked.

b380e68feef6.text: You get a notification when you receive a season medal.

73faffb319ca.text: Refreshing the page no longer loses your place in a friend's practice server.

e3c406a4f6e5.text: Lineups you save on your practice server now appear right away in a This Server group at the top of Mine, numbered in save order.

0f623e14623b.text: A Utility tab shows every grenade on CT and T maps, checked against the common lineups, with Watch and Save.

9c95c29fcc17.text: Lineups with saved bots show a badge on the map, and each bot's spot when you open the lineup.

ba7d7b39440b.text: Audio stays in sync with the picture on long live streams.

4251e90f2db1.text: Live streams stay closer to real time when they fall behind.

27c3b916cbea.text: A clip's thumbnail is now saved before the clip is finished, so fewer clips appear without one.

6d2369f6016b.text: Only the team owner can hand over a team, and the owner can no longer be removed or demoted by others.

d2a7afa0eb73.text: Teams can pick a country, shown as a flag beside the team name on team pages, match pages and tournament team lists.

683171ad75cd.text: The match filters on player profiles fit on one line on more screen sizes.

7b71d4a13c54.text: The Save button in the team editor is fully visible again on every screen size.

fb88f3c58049.text: Restart Map now warns that recorded rounds will be set aside.

e08f90f97e35.text: Restoring a round no longer counts kills and damage from the interrupted round twice.

fb69a6a08ec0.text: Only staff can restore rounds or restart a map from the match page.
